category_title: Students with blindness and autism sensitive to environmental noise and tactile distractors
scenario_title: Task initiation with visually based language and unstructured directions
minimal_context: The student is in a regular inclusive classroom listening to the teacher's instructions on what materials to take out for an assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, let's get started on the new assignment. Look up here at the front to see what materials you need to take out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don’t know where to start. The teacher needs to tell me exactly what to take out and what to do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look here at the example I'm holding up, it shows everything you need.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They tell everyone to ‘look here’ and ‘look there’… but I can’t look so I don’t understand what they mean.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to keep moving, just try your best to get your things ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It’s bad when they say that! Things are going too fast and I still don't know what to take out or what to do.
